proof_body:
by
  intro f a b hc hd x hx
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx.1 with rfl | h
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨c, _, e⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) h (hc.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hx.2)) (fun y hy => hd y ⟨hy.1, hy.2.trans_le hx.2⟩)
    have hne : x - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h.ne'
    have h0 : f x - f a = 0 := by
      have := (eq_div_iff hne).mp e
      linarith
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f 0 x) → ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = f a
